children: Indonesia's new finance minister Suahasil Nazara pledged at a press conference on Friday to refund taxpayers who have overpaid, in accordance with regulations.
Suahasil took over as finance minister this week, replacing Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa, who had requested more audits of tax refunds, causing delays.
